title: KAITO — It's All In The Mixing!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Welcome, everyone!
Please come in and wait inside.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hi, everyone!
Did Len and KAITO ask you to come over?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yes. I guess that means you're all here for the same reason.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I wonder what's happening. And there's a really nice smell coming from the kitchen...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, it smells like... Is someone baking something?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm looking forward to finding out what.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, everyone! Thanks for coming!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Sure, but what are you and KAITO up to?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: All you have to do is take a look at these... Ta-daa!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh wow...! It's a basket full of cookies!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We were wondering what smelled so good! It was these cookies!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. We thought they'd be a good way to thank you guys for Valentine's Day, so I had KAITO teach me how to bake them!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, Len, you baked these?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yup! We even baked a bunch of different kinds. Plain ones, chocolate chip ones, some with tea leaves mixed in and even some with matcha!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: This is our White Day gift for all of you! Please, have as many as you like!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then, let's...

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Dig in!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Is it okay for us to also have some, Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Of course! You guys too, Akito, Toya! Have as many as you like!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thanks. In that case...

rows.Speaker: Akito, Toya, Kohane & An
rows.Line: Let's eat.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Mmm! It's so crispy and yummy!
I'm gonna have a chocolate chip one next!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The matcha ones are also very good. They have a really nice flavor to them.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: These tea-flavored cookies are so good...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I can feel this aroma of tea spreading throughout my mouth.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay, the actual tea's also ready, so why not try them together?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
We did it, Len!
Look at how much they're all enjoying everything!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! Thanks for helping me with this, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: The truth is, for lending me a hand, I've prepared a little surprise for you...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wait, you did?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Ta-daa!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Wow! This cookie's gigantic!
Hm...? Or rather...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, KAITO, that cookie looks just like you!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I know it's not perfect, but I think I managed to capture your most prominent features...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I can see that it's me... But...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: He seems much more lovable than me. I'm honestly a little jealous.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Of a cookie?

rows.Speaker: Kohane & An
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Haha!
Hehe.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Nice work, KAITO.
As thanks, here's some coffee...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Huh? As thanks?
What did I do to deserve this?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You helped Len, no?
I think you've earned a little reward.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I had a feeling that you two were getting something ready for White Day since it was fast approaching...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But it didn't seem right for me to butt in... So, I'm glad you saw this plan through until the end.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. So you knew...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, I need to thank you as well.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you for not telling the others, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Still... You really did play a big role this time around, KAITO. Not only did you help Len, but you even helped Miku and Toya.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. I am more reliable than you give me credit for, you know?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, you are.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
KAITO! MEIKO!
There's still plenty of cookies, so feel free to have some more!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: There are? Then, I'd like a chocolate chip one!
